title: the chain tool lists every berth at a stage, carried ones included
intention: chain publishes stage_packet_paths(stage, *, berths_root=None): every berth path at a stage in the default store, plus each commons-carried berth this box lacks, local copy first, through the same index claiming_packet_paths reads.
why: Law 7 (a diagnostic surface reading short is a red, gating or not): 2026-11-19 on akiendelllinux, by /home/akien/.cairn/devices/cc/0/scratch/akiendelllinux_cc_0/skillseals/measure_residue_none.py: one orient berth with an unresolvable ref. Held in the local chart store, forwarding_residue(None) asks 1 pair and leaves 1 unanswered; held only in the commons mirror, it asks 0. The global report (cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py:906, read by cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector/probes/does_the_derivation_keep_up.py) globs _CHART_BERTHS alone, and live, 308 of the 3367 CairnCommons/berths/chart berths are absent from this box's store. Chain publishes only per-ticket readers (claiming_packet_paths, claiming_packets); listing every berth at a stage, carried ones included, has no public reader in cairn/tools/chain/chain.py. Sibling of ad3aece2650b (the per-component mode), 072a482e6dd7, 1e99a571dd6d, 7cae18f7f9c2.
traces_to: Law 7; RULE 1 (one reader, the chain tool's)
how: In cairn/tools/chain/chain.py: a public stage_packet_paths(stage, *, berths_root=None) returning sorted-by-name paths: the local */packets/<stage>-*.json glob (claimless berths included) plus, where _mirror_for(root) names a mirror, each <stage>-*.json there whose basename is not local. Proof: a scratch store and mirror swapped in as cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_component_sieves_read_a_far_box_chart_by_its_commons_copy.py does.

clauses.claim: over the default store, a berth held only in the commons mirror is listed at its stage, and a berth held in both is listed once, at its local path
an explicit berths_root lists only itself, and a berth that names no ticket, held locally, is still listed

decisions.text: D1: stage_packet_paths joins cairn/tools/chain/chain.py's public functions, reading the local glob and _mirror_for as _packet_index does.
D2: red-first proof cairn/tools/chain/proofs/test_a_stage_reader_lists_carried_berths.py, one tooth per clause.
